title: Add Internet Identity Auth, User Registration, Profile Modal, Admin Panel, and React Query Hooks

requirements.text: Extend the Motoko backend actor in backend/main.mo with user registration and admin-only functions: (1) `registerUser(name: Text, phone: Text, area: Text)` — stores a user profile keyed by the caller's principal, recording name, phone, service area, and signup timestamp; if the principal already exists, update the profile; (2) `getMyProfile()` — returns the caller's own profile as an optional record; (3) `getUsers()` — admin-only, returns all registered user profiles as an array; (4) `deleteUser(p: Principal)` — admin-only, removes the user profile for the given principal; (5) `deleteFeedback(id: Nat)` — admin-only, removes the feedback entry with the matching id (add an id field to stored feedback if not already present). Admin-only functions must check that the caller's principal matches a hardcoded admin principal constant defined at the top of the actor, initially set to `"2vxsx-fae"` with a comment instructing the deployer to replace it with their actual Internet Identity principal.
acceptanceCriteria: `registerUser` saves a new profile or updates an existing one keyed by caller principal
`getMyProfile` returns the caller's profile if it exists, or null/empty if not
`getUsers` returns all profiles and traps/returns error if caller is not the admin principal
`deleteUser` removes the specified principal's profile and traps if caller is not admin
`deleteFeedback` removes the feedback entry with the given id and traps if caller is not admin
Each feedback entry has a unique Nat id field
Admin principal constant is defined at the top of the actor with a comment to replace it

requirements.text: Add Internet Identity sign-in/sign-out UI to the Header component (`frontend/src/components/Header.tsx`). When the user is not authenticated, show a 'Sign In' button styled with brand colors (#FFD700/#FF8C42). When authenticated, show a small avatar icon with the user's name (if a profile exists) or a truncated principal, and a 'Sign Out' option inline or in a dropdown. Use the existing `useInternetIdentity` hook to manage auth state. On successful login, if the user has no stored profile (checked via `useMyProfile`), open the ProfileModal.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Sign In' button is visible in the header when not authenticated
Clicking 'Sign In' triggers the Internet Identity login flow
After login, the header shows the user's name or truncated principal
A 'Sign Out' option is available and logs the user out
If no profile exists after login, the ProfileModal is opened automatically

requirements.text: Create a ProfileModal React component at `frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx` that appears as a centered modal overlay after first login when no profile exists. It must contain a form with three fields: Full Name (text input), Phone Number (text input), and Service Area (a select listing: Mahipalpur Extension, Mahipalpur Village, Aerocity, Vasant Kunj, Rangpuri, Nagal Dewat). A 'Save Profile' button calls the backend `registerUser` function via the actor, then closes the modal and invalidates the React Query cache for the profile query. A 'Skip for now' link dismisses the modal without saving. The modal must match the dark-themed design (#111111 background, #FFD700/#FF8C42 accents, white text, semi-transparent backdrop).
acceptanceCriteria: Modal renders as a centered overlay with semi-transparent backdrop
Form has Full Name, Phone Number, and Service Area fields
Service Area select lists all six localities
'Save Profile' calls registerUser and closes modal on success
React Query profile cache is invalidated after successful save
'Skip for now' closes modal without any backend call
Design matches dark theme with #FFD700/#FF8C42 accents

requirements.text: Create an AdminPage React component at `frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx` and add a `/admin` route in the application (using React Router or hash-based routing consistent with existing patterns). The page must: (1) check if the authenticated user's principal matches the hardcoded admin principal — if not authenticated or not admin, display an 'Access Denied' message with a link back to the homepage; (2) show a 'Registered Users' table with columns: Principal (truncated), Name, Phone, Service Area, Signup Date; (3) show a 'Customer Feedback' table with columns: Reviewer Name, Rating (stars), Message, Date, and a Delete button per row; (4) the Delete button in the Feedback table calls the backend `deleteFeedback(id)` function and refreshes the feedback list; (5) the Delete button in the Users table calls `deleteUser(principal)` and refreshes the users list; (6) both tables are fetched via React Query using the authenticated actor; (7) match the dark-themed design (#0d0d0d background, #FFD700/#FF8C42 accents, white text).
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /admin while unauthenticated shows 'Access Denied' with a home link
Navigating to /admin as a non-admin authenticated user shows 'Access Denied'
Admin user sees a Registered Users table with all specified columns
Admin user sees a Customer Feedback table with all specified columns
Delete button on feedback row calls deleteFeedback and refreshes the list
Delete button on user row calls deleteUser and refreshes the list
Both tables use React Query with the authenticated actor
Design matches dark theme specification

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks to `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` for the new backend functions: (1) `useMyProfile()` — fetches the authenticated user's profile using `getMyProfile()`, enabled only when the actor is available; (2) `useAllUsers()` — fetches all registered users using `getUsers()`, enabled only when the authenticated actor is available; (3) a mutation hook `useRegisterUser()` — calls `registerUser(name, phone, area)` on the actor and invalidates the profile query on success; (4) a mutation hook `useDeleteUser()` — calls `deleteUser(principal)` and invalidates the users list query on success; (5) a mutation hook `useDeleteFeedback()` — calls `deleteFeedback(id)` and invalidates the feedback list query on success. All hooks must follow the existing `useActor` hook pattern already present in the codebase.
acceptanceCriteria: `useMyProfile` returns the current user's profile when authenticated, disabled when no actor
`useAllUsers` returns all users when authenticated, disabled when no actor
`useRegisterUser` mutation calls registerUser and invalidates the profile cache on success
`useDeleteUser` mutation calls deleteUser and invalidates the users list cache on success
`useDeleteFeedback` mutation calls deleteFeedback and invalidates the feedback cache on success
All hooks follow the existing actor/query patterns in useQueries.ts

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, ui components)
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture)
Service prices must remain unchanged: Plumber ₹499, Electrician ₹299, Fan/Cooler ₹199, AC Repair ₹479, Mechanic ₹399
Admin principal placeholder must be set to '2vxsx-fae' with a comment to replace it
nonGoals: Email/password authentication — only Internet Identity is used
Role-based access control beyond a single hardcoded admin principal
Editing existing user profiles from the admin panel
Any changes to existing sections (Hero, Services, About, Contact, FAQ, Footer, etc.)
